Example import highlightSearchMatch from '@/utils/highlightSearchMatch' const SearchResult = ({ text, query }) => { return (
{highlightSearchMatch(text, query)}
) } // Usage // Renders: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" // Case-insensitive matching // Renders: "Hello World" // Multiple matches // Renders: "The cat sat on the mat" Params PARAM DESCRIPTION TYPE DEFAULT text The text content to search within. string - searchTerm The term to highlight in the text. string - Return RETURN DESCRIPTION TYPE DEFAULT highlightedContent Text with highlighted matches as React elements.
